headline: Giants place Jaxson Dart on injured reserve
summary: Jaxson Dart's season is over and the Giants officially moved him off of their active roster on Thursday.

headline: Nick Chubb will sign one-day contract to retire with Browns

headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold: 'Striving' to make return Sunday
summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold was limited Wednesday as he returned to practice after missing most of the first two games because of a glute injury.

headline: Brian Burns, Andrew Thomas miss Thursday's Giants practice
summary: Word on Wednesday was that Giants linebacker Brian Burns is likely to miss time with a sprained ankle and Thursday's practice did nothing to suggest otherwise.
